claim: Zhu et al. report a mean duration of 1.8 minutes for ED-intern task episodes labelled Consulting more senior ED medical staff, across 878 observed episodes (Box 2). The study observed 42 interns from three Melbourne city public teaching-hospital EDs over 390.8 hours between 1 August and 31 December 2006. This is an observed mean for intern task episodes, not a duration distribution, senior clinician active-work duration, or generic/Cairns default. The study calculated task means as total activity time divided by activity frequency. A single researcher observed activities with a stopwatch; where activities were simultaneous, only the principal activity was recorded, so the measure does not identify concurrent resource occupancy.
